description: This file defines the Marker class for the Leaflet mapping library. It extends the Layer class and provides functionality for draggable, customizable markers on a map, including icon management, positioning, opacity, and interaction features.

classes.name: Marker
classes.description: A class to create map markers that can be clicked and dragged, with customizable icons and interaction options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Marker with a specified latitude/longitude and options.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the marker to the map, initializing icons, and setting up animation if enabled.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the marker is removed from the map, including removing event hooks and elements.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for map events (zoom and viewreset) to update marker position.

methods.name: getLatLng
methods.description: Returns the current geographical location of the marker.

methods.name: setLatLng
methods.description: Sets a new geographical position for the marker and fires a 'move' event.

methods.name: setZIndexOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the z-index offset of the marker.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the current icon used for the marker.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Updates the marker's icon and refreshes its appearance.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the HTML element that represents the marker.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the marker's position on the map based on its current latlng.

methods.name: _initIcon
methods.description: Initializes or updates the marker's icon element, handling icon creation, class assignment, shadow, and accessibility.

methods.name: _removeIcon
methods.description: Removes the icon element from the DOM.

methods.name: _removeShadow
methods.description: Removes the shadow element from the DOM.

methods.name: _setPos
methods.description: Sets the position of the icon and shadow elements on the map layer.

methods.name: _updateZIndex
methods.description: Updates the z-index of the marker's icon element.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Animates the marker position during zoom transitions.

methods.name: _initInteraction
methods.description: Enables interactive behavior such as dragging and pointer cursor styles.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Changes the opacity of the marker.

methods.name: _updateOpacity
methods.description: Applies the opacity setting to icon and shadow elements.

methods.name: _bringToFront
methods.description: Raises the marker to the top of z-index stacking when hovered.

methods.name: _resetZIndex
methods.description: Resets the z-index to its default position.

methods.name: _getPopupAnchor
methods.description: Returns the popup anchor point based on icon options.

methods.name: _getTooltipAnchor
methods.description: Returns the tooltip anchor point based on icon options.

methods.name: marker(latlng, options)
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Marker instance.
